methodology.production_method: db_list_tasks(Runtime*, NULL, limit, ...), compiled from src/db.c
methodology.candidate_method: db_list_tasks_candidate(), test-only path compiled with ASGEND_DB_PERF_BENCHMARK
methodology.database_pairing: same deterministic task fixture, separate DB files, order alternated across paired runs
methodology.warmup: three calls per worker excluded from samples
methodology.cold_cache: OS cache is not flushed; first call after db_init reported separately and is not labelled cold cache
methodology.serialization: json-c compact serialization timed separately after API return
methodology.mutex: Runtime.db_mutex acquisition wait instrumented only in this benchmark target; production build has instrumentation compiled out
